t a controller run (foundation-safe; no model/GitHub writes)
  status    Show latest persisted run state
  doctor    Validate environment/config/adapters
  dry-run   Inspect and plan without repository mutation
  resume    Reconcile interrupted run and safely resume foundation checks
  logs      Show recent structured events
  costs     Show persisted model/GitHub write counters
  stop      Request controller stop
  selftest  Run controller fault-injection/self-tests
  help      Show this help
